name: Gin no Hebi Kuro no Tsuki
source:
Main character is an unrivaled masked swordsman who takes up killer jobs and searches for a swordsman stronger than himself.
In the same world there is a girl Mari used in experiments by her father searching for immortality.
The fate connects these two people in their constant struggle.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名无敌的蒙面剑士，以接杀手任务为生，同时寻找比自己更强的剑士。在同一个世界里，有一个名叫真里的女孩，被追求长生不老的父亲当作实验品。命运将这两个人连接在了一起，在不断的挣扎中交织。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
